summary: Iteration 3 testing complete. Backend: 7/7 regression tests passing (login, public reference-persons, reference-tree GET/PUT noop, public reference-tree, registrations/count, /api/admin/dashboard). Frontend: source review of all 9 modified files + live DOM probe via super admin login. ReferenceTreePicker overlay removed and container sized 360/460px (source confirms .rd3-tree-wrap @ 360px / @media >=640px 460px); autoZoom useMemo clamps to [0.42, 0.85]; recentre useEffect at 250ms+600ms after selection.
